Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.agent

Record Class AgentRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.agent.AgentRequest
public record AgentRequest(@Size(max=32) String name, @Size(max=1024) String description, @Size(max=1024) String systemPrompt, Integer memorySize, @Size(max=64) String llmModel, Double temperature, Integer maxOutputTokens, Double topP, @Size(max=256) List<@Size(max=64) String> tools, @Size(max=256) List<@Size(max=64) String> enabledMcpServers, @Size(max=256) List<UUID> team) extends Record
Request body for POST /agents and PUT /agents/{id}.

Mirror of the AgentRequest schema in openapi.yaml. Every structural / range check is deferred to the domain value objects (the controller constructs AgentName, MemorySize, Team, SamplingParams at the boundary); the bean-validation annotations here are upper-bound length / list-size guards that short-circuit before the controller body runs.
